caseName: United States v. East Side Canal & Irrigation Co.
caseNameFull: United States v. EAST SIDE CANAL & IRRIGATION COMPANY AND STEVINSON WATER DISTRICT

opinions.text:
Eminent domain; taking of appropriative rights to certain waters of San Joaquin River. Judgment for plaintiff.

Defendant’s petition for writ of certiorari denied by the Supreme Court June 5, 1950.
